exposure: Women who underwent cesarean delivery (planned or after labor)
Mode of delivery (cesarean delivery vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 344 women with BMIs of 50 or greater delivering a live fetus at 34 weeks of gestation or greater
finding: Labor is associated with lower composite maternal and neonatal morbidity in women with superobesity, despite high rates of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Severe maternal morbidity may be higher in women who require a cesarean delivery after labor.
